question: Under the same meta supervision and adaptation budget, does the order penalty add utility?

labels.INCOMPLETE: any required arm non-OK in a primary condition (failure, cap, NOT_RUN) or missing paired rows
labels.ORDER_PENALTY_ADDED_UTILITY_NOT_SUPPORTE: any of: stationary gain vs no_adapt seed-mean < MIE or <= 0 in some seed; std-over-orders reduction vs tent_full seed-mean < MIE or <= 0 in some seed; some required control not dominated (better on mean error or std by MIE with the same sign in all 3 seeds, and not worse than tolerance on the other axis); drift regime-end or online error worse than utility-only by more than tolerance, or below no_adapt
labels.REALDATA_PILOT_CANDIDATE: none of the above; a flag for a later, separately approved pilot only

decision.no_rescue: if not supported: no lambda/seed/model sweep; further training of this candidate is paused
